_comment: BOOTSTRAP COPY. The real file is apps/parfast/shared/strings/en.json, owned by chip B (parfast-gui-mac). Parfast.Gen prefers that path when it exists on disk and falls back to this one, so the Windows build switches with no edit the day chip B lands it. Do not fix a difference here; report it in the handoff. Copy rules: no em-dashes or en-dashes as punctuation, the banned word from CLAUDE.md invariant 6 never appears, sentence case for buttons on both platforms (Fluent guidance is sentence case too).
